sections.question: Is LibroFlare really free?
sections.answer: Yes, LibroFlare offers completely free access to all media in our library.

sections.question: Can I access the library anytime?
sections.answer: Yes, our library is available 24/7. You can read whatever and whenever you want!

sections.question: Do I need to create an account?
sections.answer: While you can explore our library completely free and without an account, creating one gives you access to more personalized features.

sections.question: Can I download books for offline reading?
sections.answer: Currently, LibroFlare is focused on online reading. We may add offline support in the future.

sections.question: How do I report an issue or request a new book?
sections.answer: You can contact us through our support page or via email for any issues or book requests.
